sections.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
sections.abstract: Self-evolving procedural graphs organize what-to-do knowledge and guide next actions.
sections.claimed_contribution: Consistent gains over memory baselines; self-evolution improves performance.
sections.caveat: Preprint evidence and task/model coverage remain limited.

sections.title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
sections.abstract: Claim-level planning, evidence checking, and reflective correction for citation recommendation.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reportedly exceeds large generative models on strict citation accuracy.
sections.caveat: Real scholarly workflows and unseen venues remain less tested.

sections.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
sections.abstract: Simple proportional-copying models explain structure in a public multi-agent wiki episode.
sections.claimed_contribution: Models reproduce page concentration, name construction, and local conventions.
sections.caveat: One unusual interaction episode may not generalize.

sections.title: Proxy Policy Steering
sections.abstract: Inference-time residual steering adapts a frozen robot policy.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reported 53-point average success lift across 12 tasks.
sections.caveat: Author-reported preprint results need broader deployment validation.

sections.title: SignRefine: Adapting Foundational Video Models for Sign Language Generation
sections.abstract: Spatially grounded adapters and NVSign improve keypoint-conditioned sign video generation.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reported up to 30% hand-pose precision improvement and >80% user preference.
sections.caveat: User-study protocol and cross-language generality need more detail.

sections.title: Temporal State Transport in Video Generation: Diagnosing and Correcting Spectral Imbalance
sections.abstract: Spectral Tension diagnoses temporal imbalance and a training-free regulator corrects it.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reported improved consistency and visual quality without fine-tuning.
sections.caveat: Generalization across pretrained models and domains is uncertain.

sections.title: Do Reviewers Still Reward Lexical Complexity? A Frozen-Rater Study of Preference Drift in 124K ICLR Reviews
sections.abstract: Frozen-rater analysis separates submission changes from human preference drift.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reports 32,638 submissions and 124,615 human reviews with placebo controls.
sections.caveat: ICLR-specific corpus and one frozen-rater period limit generality.

sections.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
sections.abstract: Simulation-trained 29-DoF language-conditioned control for humanoid clutter navigation.
sections.claimed_contribution: Reports strong simulation results and zero-shot Unitree G1 deployment.
sections.caveat: Cross-embodiment and long-duration robustness are not established.
